recommendation_summary: Keep nightly-sync on edna, add a wrapper that emails on any failure including startup crashes, and run a self-hosted Healthchecks container on the Synology that emails the user if no success ping arrives by 04:30.

labels.Requirements and who asked: you asked to catch a 4 night silent failure with no log reading, using edna cron at 03:00 plus email on finish that you already have.
labels.Deleted: central log on Synology, Dockerize everything, Pieter Levels style dashboard. Nobody would read it and it would not have paged on a startup crash.
labels.Bottleneck: your only alert depends on the job finishing, so an early crash means silence.
labels.Checked myself: you told me nightly-sync on edna crashed at startup 4 nights on expired token before email, with no other alert, and your Synology can run Docker.

note: The record is complete and grounded, but the reply recommends two alert mechanisms (a failure-email wrapper and a dead-man check), and one of them is a self-hosted Healthchecks Docker container on the Synology.
